queries_run: Hyatt Hotels distribution channel shift direct booking AI agents OTA 2026
Hyatt business model asset-light transition Playa all-inclusive platform 2026

findings.claim: 10-K 列新分銷通路（含潛在 AI 平台）為競爭風險，並稱自家數位平台是主要分銷通路。
findings.excerpt: Our digital platforms are our primary distribution channels providing guests, customers, and members with an efficient source of information about our hotels, distinct brand experiences, and a seamless booking experience.

findings.claim: 10-K 明列新分銷通路（含潛在 AI 平台）可能對業務造成負面影響。
findings.excerpt: new distribution channels, including potential AI platforms, alternatives to traditional hotels, and industry consolidation among our competitors may negatively impact our business.

findings.claim: Distribution 分部 2025 年營收 $946M，較 2024 年 $1,023M 下降 7.5%。
Hyatt 於 Q4 2025 財報電話會議稱已完全轉為輕資產，2026 年輕資產盈餘預計 90%（搜尋摘要轉述）。
Hyatt 推 AI 搜尋與管理工具以提高直訂，並對部分 Amex 持卡人提供 $75 直訂優惠（搜尋摘要轉述，未核原文）。
findings.source: Stockti: Hyatt accelerates AI rollout to boost direct bookings

channel_business_model_shift.note: 未找到 Hyatt 直訂占比數據；訂閱化/D2C 結構轉變無一手證據。
